proof_method: Spawn real API (uvicorn windagent_api.main:app) and real Worker (python -m windagent_worker) as independent OS processes sharing one SQLite file; drive full task lifecycle over HTTP.
scenario_steps: 1. Empty SQLite DB + migration marker (revision 002) created.
4. Worker process started (python -m windagent_worker) and reached readiness; heartbeat recorded.
5. POST /api/v2/tasks submitted a mock-safe task -> 201, written to durable queue (task_runs state=pending).
6. Worker claimed task via SqlDurableTaskQueue.claim_next (fencing token issued).
7. Worker renewed heartbeat lease (fencing token validated).
8. ExecutionRuntimeRegistry dispatched task (FakeRuntimeAdapter under WINDAGENT_FAKE_RUNTIME=1) -> mock-safe execution.
9. Worker committed terminal state (task_runs state=completed) under SqlUnitOfWork.
10. GET /api/v2/tasks/{id} returned status=COMPLETED (proves cross-process durability; API reads worker-written state).
11. Worker process stopped; subsequent GET /health/ready shows worker DEGRADED (not DOWN) -> API survives worker failure.
real_defects_fixed: API create_task never enqueued to durable queue (Worker could not claim). Wired SqlWorkSubmissionAdapter into ApplicationContainer + v2_tasks.create_task.
Worker never persisted terminal state back to task_runs (stayed 'running'). Added SqlUnitOfWork save_facts(completed) in poll_and_execute_tick.
Worker ignored WINDAGENT_DATABASE_URL and used default windagent.db in CWD, so it read a DIFFERENT DB than API. WorkerContainer.bootstrap now honors the env var.
Health checker referenced non-existent registry methods (list_providers/list_tools/list_workflows, awaited sync calls) -> readiness DOWN. Fixed to sync introspection.
Health queue check queried non-existent 'durable_queue' table -> changed to task_runs.
Health schema_migration requires migration_history table (no Alembic runner in repo) -> E2E creates the marker as part of 'run migrations'.
